import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.InputMismatchException;
import java.util.stream.IntStream;

public class G2V1 {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static FastScanner in;
    static PrintWriter out;
    static boolean oj = System.getProperty("ONLINE_JUDGE") != null;
    static String INPUT = "";

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        in = oj ? new FastScanner(System.in) : new FastScanner(new ByteArrayInputStream(INPUT.getBytes()));
        out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
        solve();
        out.flush();
        if (!oj) System.out.println("[" + (System.currentTimeMillis() - start) + "ms]");
    }

    static void solve() {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        long inv = invl(m + 1, MOD);
        long ans = (1 + inv * n) % MOD;
        long base = inv * ((long) m * (m + 2 + (n - 1)) % MOD) % MOD;
        long u = IntStream.rangeClosed(1, n).mapToLong(i -> invl(i, MOD)).sum() % MOD;
        ans = (base * u + ans) % MOD;
        out.println(ans);
    }

    static long invl(long a, long mod) {
        if (a <= 0) return 0;
        return modPow(a % mod, mod - 2, mod);
    }

    static long modPow(long a, long e, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) res = res * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static class FastScanner {
        InputStream is;
        byte[] inbuf = new byte[1024];
        int lenbuf = 0, ptrbuf = 0;

        FastScanner(InputStream is) {
            this.is = is;
        }

        int readByte() {
            if (lenbuf == -1) throw new InputMismatchException();
            if (ptrbuf >= lenbuf) {
                ptrbuf = 0;
                try {
                    lenbuf = is.read(inbuf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new InputMismatchException();
                }
                if (lenbuf <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return inbuf[ptrbuf++];
        }

        boolean isSpaceChar(int c) {
            return !(c >= 33 && c <= 126);
        }

        int skip() {
            int b;
            while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && isSpaceChar(b));
            return b;
        }

        int nextInt() {
            int num = 0, b;
            boolean minus = false;
            while ((b = readByte()) != -1 && !((b >= '0' && b <= '9') || b == '-'));
            if (b == '-') {
                minus = true;
                b = readByte();
            }
            while (true) {
                if (b >= '0' && b <= '9') {
                    num = num * 10 + (b - '0');
                } else {
                    return minus ? -num : num;
                }
                b = readByte();
            }
        }
    }
}
